import math int floor_ratio(int numerator, int denominator) if denominator < 0 return floor_ratio(-numerator, -denominator) return if numerator >= 0 then numerator / denominator else -((-numerator + denominator - 1) / denominator) int rounded(int numerator, int denominator) if denominator < 0 return rounded(-numerator, -denominator) return floor_ratio(2 * numerator + denominator, 2 * denominator)
